title: Find the width and endpoints
text: The width is $$dx=\frac{1}{n}$$ and the left endpoints are $$\frac{i-1}{n}$$, which run from $$0$$ up to almost $$1$$.

title: Identify f
text: The value at each left endpoint $$x$$ is $$x$$ itself, so the limit is the integral of $$x$$ from $$0$$ to $$1$$.
